jobs.title: Senior Director, People
jobs.description:
Construction is the second-largest industry in the world—nearly 4x the size of SaaS—yet it still operates without the automated feedback loops that modern software teams rely on. Without real-time observability, issues are detected too late, contributing to over $3 Trillion in annual global waste.

Doxel brings computer vision and AI to construction, giving teams real-time visibility into progress, risk, and execution. From hospitals to data centers, and from field leaders to executive teams, Doxel is used every day to support better decisions and faster delivery. Our platform is trusted by industry leaders including Shell, Genentech, HCA Healthcare, Kaiser, Turner, and Layton.

Doxel’s automated progress tracking solution keeps teams aligned with hard facts that leave no ambiguity on where the project is today, where it will be tomorrow and what decisions need to be made to land it on schedule and on budget. This enables our customers to deliver projects, on average, 11% ahead of schedule with up to 16% savings on monthly cash flow.

Backed by Insight Partners and Andreessen Horowitz and with a rapidly growing team of engineers, scientists, construction veterans, and Enterprise go-to-market teams, we're driven to help our customers win. 

Join us as we continue our journey to transform the $15T Construction Industry! 



The Role
You'll design the people systems and processes our company scales and thrives on: how we level and pay, how we onboard, how we grow and promote, and how we manage performance. The raw material is strong — a high-talent team, support for modern tooling, and leaders who care about performance as much as you do. You default to AI-forward thinking — using modern tools to make People processes faster, sharper, and more scalable, not just to keep up with them.
This is a builder's seat, not a maintenance role. You'll report directly to our CEO, with the mandate and autonomy to shape how Doxel hires, develops, and retains talent as we scale — and the trust to build it right the first time.

Your Day To Day
- Talent engine.  Recruiting execution has dedicated owners — you make the machine around them world-class: hiring velocity, interview quality, decision discipline, and a candidate experience that closes the people we want most.

- Performance Management, Career Pathing & Manager Development. Partner with Finance on leveling architecture and benchmarking (Pave/Carta); design offer strategy. Own and evolve our career pathing framework so growth criteria at every level are clear and defensible. Run merit and promotion cycles end to end, including calibration. Directly coach and develop our people managers — especially first-time managers — through performance conversations, calibration, and promotion decisions.

- People platform (HRIS). Rippling is our HRIS and you own it: job architecture, approval workflows, onboarding that impresses on day one, offboarding that's airtight.

- Employee Relations. Be the first line on ER issues handling them with rigor in accordance with company policies, while coaching managers through difficult situations before they escalate.

- Benefits, total rewards & employee support. Own benefits strategy and annual renewals with our broker, 401(k) administration, and payroll operations across [confirm: two countries, or more — flagging the discrepancy with the "11+ countries" line elsewhere]. Make our rewards competitive, understood, and efficient. Support immigration needs (H-1B and related, with dedicated outside counsel), mobility.

- Learning & Development. We have a track record of growing up-and-coming managers into senior leaders. You will own and grow the learning & development program to scale this success.

We hire and promote on one criterion: the best person for every job. We expect our People leader to build systems that are rigorously fair and rigorously excellent, and to keep the function anchored to mission and merit.
What Success Looks Like
- You're hungry to build from the ground up and partner directly with the CEO on a daily basis

- You default to AI-forward thinking — using modern tools to make People processes faster, sharper, and more scalable, not just to keep up with them.

- A true generalist with depth: credible on career pathing conversations comp architecture one day, an immigration case the next, an HRIS workflow redesign the day after

- A player/coach. You build the model, configure the system, and run the process yourself — then systematize so it scales

- Experienced with multi-entity or international operations is a big plus

- Fluent in modern people tooling — Rippling or comparable HRIS; Pave/Carta

- Trusted at both altitudes: executives & employees
What You Bring
- 10+ years of blended Recruiting and HR experience

- At least 2+ years within an Enterprise SaaS environment

- Experience at a growth-stage company (roughly 50–300 headcount during tenure)

- Comfortable evaluating and integrating AI-powered tools into People workflows (e.g., interview intelligence, performance calibration support, L&D content creation) — not just using AI, but knowing where it genuinely improves rigor vs. where it doesn't

- Talent Engine: Experience building or significantly improving hiring infrastructure, with measurable and effective KPIs (time-to-fill, offer-accept rate, interviewer scorecard consistency, etc.)

- Performance Management, Career Pathing & Manager Development:

- Has run performance review/merit/promotion or calibration cycles directly, not just supported them

- Has built or owned a career pathing framework — clear criteria for what growth looks like at each level, not just comp bands tied to titles

- Has direct experience developing first-time or early-stage people managers — coaching them through their first performance conversations, calibration debates, or promotion decisions, not just training them once and moving on

- Comfortable coaching managers through difficult performance conversations in real time

- HRIS ownership: Hands-on experience owning an HRIS (Rippling or comparable) — configuring job architecture, approval workflows, onboarding/offboarding flows — not just using one as an end user

- Employee Relations: Demonstrated experience handling ER issues directly — investigations, terminations, conflict escalation, manager coaching
Preferred Experience
- Compensation & benchmarking: Comfort constructing offers and leveling using benchmarking data (Pave, Radford, or similar; Carta for equity) — noting compensation budget currently sits with Finance, so this is closer to fluency and partnership than sole ownership today

- Multi-entity/international experience: We currently operate across 11+ countries, so background in international HR operations and best practices is very helpful

- Benefits & Total Rewards: Experience owning benefits strategy and running an annual renewal with a broker; familiarity with 401(k) administration and multi-country payroll operations

- Immigration: Prior experience supporting or managing employer-sponsored immigration cases
Doxel is an equal opportunity employer and actively seeks diversity at our company. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.

Your Day To Day
- Category Leadership: Define, name, and lead the category Doxel is creating at the intersection of AI and construction

- Strategic Leadership: Define and execute the overarching marketing strategy for Doxel, ensuring alignment with company goals and category-creation objectives

- Product Marketing Expertise: Own positioning, differentiation, persona messaging, and customer narrative — making Doxel's story simple, credible, and commercially useful. Partner with sales so every deck, pricing conversation, proposal, and executive narrative reflects cohesive, differentiated messaging — updated in real time as the market shifts

- Corporate Marketing & Thought Leadership: Own category narrative, brand, and market-level storytelling; establish Doxel as a thought leader on operational insight, AI adoption, and construction industry change through original content and points of view

- Demand Generation & Field Marketing: Support teams across both — directing demand gen toward a concentrated, high-value ICP (e.g., ENR 400 contractors, major owners) through account-based, sales-aligned programs, and building field marketing motions (executive dinners, regional forums, user conferences etc.) that turn customers into visible proof points and industry heroes

- Team Leadership & Coaching: Recruit, coach, and lead a lean but senior team across product marketing, corporate marketing, demand generation, and field marketing — developing the people on the team and fostering a culture of ownership and strong execution

- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Serve as a strategic partner to product, sales, and the executive team, influencing roadmap and narrative decisions and driving pipeline and revenue growth
What Success Looks Like
In the first 6–12 months:

- A sharpened Doxel narrative and category strategy

- Clear product positioning across AI, construction, owner, and GC audiences

- Cohesive sales messaging across decks, proposals, pricing, and executive conversations

- A consistent, differentiated market point of view that sales is fully enabled on

- Increased volume and quality of thought leadership content

- A distribution strategy spanning digital, field, PR, and customer channels

Over 24 months:

- Doxel's industry awareness roughly 10x today's level

- Doxel recognized as the category leader

- Doxel recognized as one of the most credible voices bringing AI to construction

- A repeatable, scalable commercial engine: messaging, enablement, and content that keep pace with the market, supported by AI-driven reporting and optimization rather than manual, after-the-fact analysis

- A marketing team with real depth across product marketing, corporate marketing, demand gen, and field marketing
What You Bring
- A track record of pioneering market-defining strategy — you've helped a company define a category from scratch, win in a crowded market, expand into a new segment, or reposition its narrative, with real evidence of business impact: category awareness lift, pipeline/revenue acceleration, win-rate improvement, sales cycle compression, or a documented shift in analyst/media/customer narrative

- Experience building positioning and messaging for multiple stakeholder personas in a complex sale — able to make something persona-specific, simple enough for reps, sophisticated enough for executive buyers, and credible to end users

- Executive presence — you operate credibly with executives, customers, and create clarity out of ambiguity, and have strong commercial judgment. You optimize for the whole company, not just marketing, and build trust quickly

- Experience playing a meaningful role in scaling a company's go-to-market engine through a significant growth stage

- A talent magnet and hands-on leader — able to attract and manage top marketing talent with credibility across marketing functions, while also building and executing alongside a lean, senior team rather than purely directing others

- AI orientation with direct application to marketing operations — you understand AI as a force reshaping how companies operate, and you've directed or overseen the use of AI tools for marketing reporting, attribution, or campaign optimization

- Prior experience at a high-growth, category defining startup, ideally within the Enterprise B2B SaaS environment

- A curious, strong communicator and strategic thinker — able to synthesize what you learn into a credible point of view, produce high-quality content under tight deadlines, and drive multiple workstreams with a bias for action

- 12+ years of progressive marketing experience, with a track record across the areas above
Preferred Experience
- Experience in high-ASP enterprise sales motions, ideally with deal sizes above $100K

- Experience in complex vertical markets

- Experience with owner/GC or construction-adjacent audience
